description: Land Title Settlement Department - Abakote, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420048
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, property boundaries, and legal status. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping - all core elements of land administration that fall under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
